<thought>Based on the exact mass (m/z 182.073) the molecular formula is C₈H₁₀N₂O₃. Two isomers from the list match this formula, but the IR spectrum shows aromatic C–H stretches (~3090 cm⁻¹) and a carbonyl stretch at 1697 cm⁻¹ without an OH band, which fits an aromatic carbonate ester rather than a carboxylic acid. The SMILES `CCOC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=NN1` corresponds to an ethyl carbonate attached to an aromatic ring containing an –NN– moiety, matching both the formula and the IR features. Therefore this is the most plausible structure for the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>CCOC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=NN1</final_answer>
